bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (mod.rs, demux/, hwdec/, queue.rs, player.rs, mp4.rs, alsa.rs, audiod/)
summary: Core Media's low-level types (sample and block buffers, CMTime, clocks and timebases, buffer queues, format descriptions) have no app-facing BifrOSt SDK equivalent. The media pipeline has internal counterparts for samples, a playback clock, frame queues, a video decoder seam and audio output, but they are owned by the media modules and the audio service rather than exposed to apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/sample_buffer.rs (SampleBuffer, SampleTiming, from_demuxed); springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs:89 (Sample: track, pts_us, dts_us, duration_us, keyframe, data); springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:46 (Sample)
features.note: SampleBuffer gives apps a coded sample with presentation, decode and duration times, a sync flag and presentation ordering, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-03.rs. Gap: samples are owned Vec<u8> values with no shared buffer object, no data-ready callbacks, no invalidation and no sample attachments.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No general block-buffer type. The DMA buffer trait covers only GPU-shared picture memory, not CPU-side sample storage.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:17 (Codec); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:101 (Codec); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:226 (VideoDecoder::configure takes codec and raw avcC/hvcC extradata)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Codec identity and parameter-set bytes are passed around as enum plus raw bytes. No format description object with dimensions, pixel aspect ratio, clean aperture or audio stream description.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs:89 (i64 microseconds); springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:46 (f64 milliseconds); springboard/src/media/player.rs:47 (Clock, f64 ms); springboard/src/media/time.rs (MediaTime, TimeRange)
features.note: MediaTime is a rational value and timescale with invalid, indefinite and infinite states, exact addition, rounding conversions to microseconds and milliseconds, and TimeRange tests containment and overlap (tests in media::time). The demuxer, sample table and player still keep their own units and do not yet use MediaTime, and apps get no time type.

features.apple: CMClock, CMAudioClock, CMTimebase (rate, anchor time, timers, time-jump notifications) (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmclock)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-core-media, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The audio thread owns the playback clock and the audio service publishes position. No timebase with rate and effective rate, no timers on a timeline, no host-time conversion, no genlock or device-drift queries.

features.apple: CMBufferQueue (enqueue, dequeue, triggers, timestamp bounds), CMSimpleQueue (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmbufferqueue)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/queue.rs; springboard/src/media/demux/mse.rs:59 (Queue, sorted by dts with a cursor)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 39 tests. Internal queues for the pipeline and for an MSE-style source buffer. No triggers, no data-ready gating, no validation handler, and not exposed as an SDK type.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No pooled allocator for large media blocks. Frames are allocated per picture.

features.feature: Video decoding and picture hand-off (image buffers)
features.apple: CMSampleBuffer image buffer path, CMSampleBufferGetImageBuffer, CMVideoFormatDescription matching (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmsamplebuffer-api)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/video_frame.rs (VideoFormat, VideoFrame, FrameStream); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:226 (VideoDecoder trait); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:212 (Frame with pts_us and pixels); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:173 (VideoLayer for the GPU); springboard/src/media/hwdec/ffmpeg.rs; springboard/src/media/hwdec/vaapi.rs
features.note: Apps can check a decoded picture against its negotiated format and queue pictures in presentation order (tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-02.rs). Gap: the decoder and VideoLayer stay in the shell, so no decoded picture reaches an app process yet; the hand-off path needs the lab machine to verify.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/aac.rs; springboard/src/media/aacstream.rs (Frame at :37); springboard/src/media/convert.rs; springboard/src/media/sbr.rs; springboard/src/media/pcm_channels.rs (ChannelBuffers)
features.note: AAC-LC decode and conversion to 48 kHz stereo S16. Interleaved PCM splits into per-channel buffers and joins back (ChannelBuffers, tested in media::pcm_channels). Packet descriptions are not exposed, and codec coverage is AAC-only in the audio path.

Output goes through ALSA's default PCM so PipeWire or PulseAudio can mix. Apps reach it through the audio service, not through a media API. Left as os in sdk-rest-02: no typed SDK client was added because the audio service's request protocol must be checked on the lab machine first.

V4L2 capture for the camera. Left as os in sdk-rest-02: a camera frame reaches apps only through the shell's camera permission flow, and no shell channel that carries frames to an app process exists yet. The ui video_device model covers node selection only.

features.apple: CMMetadata, CMTag, CMTagCollection, metadata identifiers and data-type registry (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmmetadata)
features.note: ID3 and MP4 item readers map onto common identifiers in a key-space registry, with typed values checked by identifier and unknown keys counted (tests in media::metadata). The readers still return their own fields, the collection is not yet used by the apps, and no other container has metadata.

features.apple: CMTextMarkup attribute keys (font, style, colour, layout) (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmtextmarkup)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 4 (w4-core-media, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No caption or subtitle styling model was found. springboard/src/media/demux/webm.rs was not inspected for subtitle track handling.
Stereo and projected video formats are not part of the BifrOSt desktop media scope. Camera capture is V4L2 only.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No per-sample attachments such as not-sync or dropped-frame reasons. Pipeline errors go through Result values, not notifications.

gaps: No app-facing SDK API for media samples, timing or clocks. Apps reach playback only through the audio service and the media modules.
No rational CMTime-style time type with timescale conversion, invalid and indefinite values, or time ranges.
No timebase with rate control and timers, so apps cannot drive a timeline with a rate or time jumps.
No general block buffer or memory pool for CPU-side sample data.
No text markup model for captions and subtitles.
No per-sample attachments or sample buffer notifications.
